balanced.title: I couldn’t get the code, customer service made a mistake trying to help.
balanced.text:
So I ordered three gift cards for some friends and family. Two ended up staying with me because some family members never bothered to show up. One went to my sister. This particular one.. the sticker for the code would absolutely not peel off. I even tried to scrape it off. I called customer service for help and the lady whom helped me was very nice and helpful. However, she accredited my account all three gift cards, including the one I just gave my sister for Christmas. I did not know this since I am brand new to using amazon and all this stuff. And I only called to get the code for this ONE anyways. Not all three. Now my sisters gift card is completely invalid and I just gave it to her! I wish I could perhaps have it refunded for her. I had no idea when using my gift card, the one that I called about, that hers was applied to my cart at checkout as well! After the holidays I don’t have the money to get my sister another gift card. Hopefully amazon can help refund that for her. I will update if they help. And if they don’t for that matter!.. otherwise it’s a regular gift card. So it’s fine. I’m just fuming at the mistake they cost me.

Edit for if anyone from amazon reads this. The woman that helped was incredibly nice and helpful. It was just a communication mistake I believe. But I do hope to get refunded for my one gift card for my sister so she can have her gift. Especially since I called to only get the code for ONE that wouldn’t peel off to reveal the code.

balanced.title: Be aware that card inside is cardboard and NOT plastic!
balanced.text: I can't believe I'm actually writing a review for a gift card holder, but here we are! My cupcake holder arrived dirty, and I had to clean it with an alcohol wipe to remove all the sticky black residue on the front. Not sure what could have caused said residue, as nothing sticky was present elsewhere. The gift card itself, much to my surprise, was cardboard and NOT plastic like every other card I've ordered from Amazon in the past. Because of this the card was bent and creased in three of four corners due to being wedged into the box. The box itself (once cleaned) is really cute, but the lack of quality control is seriously disappointing.

balanced.title: Handed to resident??!! I don't think so!
balanced.text: Three Amazon gift cards that are to be given to my employees as Christmas gifts. No big deal. Except that I had them shipped to my house on a Saturday knowing that someone would be at home when the package would arrive. I did not see anything show up that day, I had been checking the front door step and mailbox until 6pm (after dark, of course). This morning (the next day) I decided to check to see the status of the package, thinking that it was going to be a late arrival. Order status says that it was delivered on Saturday, and then goes on to say that it was handed to resident. That is just a flat out lie! it was lying on the porch in front of the door (fortunately!). But the doorbell had not been rung, and it certainly wasn't handed to anyone in my house. If you made the delivery and left it on the doorstep, fine, just say that. But don't lie about handing it to someone in the house. That is really irritating. I'm thankful it wasn't stolen. It was small enough that it would not have been noticed from the road, especially after dark.
